problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a series of drone surveillance flights over 11 distinct geographical checkpoints.  
The checkpoints have the following GPS coordinates:  
Checkpoint Alpha: (175,189)  
Checkpoint Beta: (171,101)  
Checkpoint Gamma: (1,92)  
Checkpoint Delta: (10,29)  
Checkpoint Epsilon: (158,0)  
Checkpoint Zeta: (69,163)  
Checkpoint Eta: (179,74)  
Checkpoint Theta: (186,58)  
Checkpoint Iota: (36,192)  
Checkpoint Kappa: (146,73)  
Checkpoint Lambda: (48,26)  

The flight distances (in kilometers) between checkpoints are predetermined:  
Alpha to Gamma: 199.2 km  
Alpha to Delta: 229.8 km  
Alpha to Epsilon: 189.8 km  
Alpha to Zeta: 109.1 km  
Alpha to Eta: 115.1 km  
Alpha to Theta: 131.5 km  
Alpha to Iota: 139.0 km  
Alpha to Kappa: 119.6 km  
Alpha to Lambda: 206.6 km  
Beta to Gamma: 170.2 km  
Beta to Delta: 176.4 km  
Beta to Epsilon: 101.8 km  
Beta to Zeta: 119.4 km  
Beta to Eta: 28.2 km  
Beta to Theta: 45.5 km  
Beta to Iota: 162.8 km  
Beta to Kappa: 37.5 km  
Beta to Lambda: 144.1 km  
Gamma to Delta: 63.6 km  
Gamma to Epsilon: 182.0 km  
Gamma to Zeta: 98.3 km  
Gamma to Eta: 178.9 km  
Gamma to Theta: 188.1 km  
Gamma to Iota: 105.9 km  
Gamma to Kappa: 146.2 km  
Gamma to Lambda: 81.0 km  
Delta to Epsilon: 150.8 km  
Delta to Zeta: 146.4 km  
Delta to Eta: 174.9 km  
Delta to Theta: 178.4 km  
Delta to Iota: 165.1 km  
Delta to Kappa: 142.9 km  
Delta to Lambda: 38.1 km  
Epsilon to Zeta: 185.7 km  
Epsilon to Eta: 76.9 km  
Epsilon to Theta: 64.4 km  
Epsilon to Iota: 227.5 km  
Epsilon to Kappa: 74.0 km  
Epsilon to Lambda: 113.0 km  
Zeta to Eta: 141.5 km  
Zeta to Theta: 157.2 km  
Zeta to Iota: 43.9 km  
Zeta to Kappa: 118.4 km  
Zeta to Lambda: 138.6 km  
Eta to Theta: 17.5 km  
Eta to Iota: 185.4 km  
Eta to Kappa: 33.0 km  
Eta to Lambda: 139.5 km  
Theta to Iota: 201.1 km  
Theta to Kappa: 42.7 km  
Theta to Lambda: 141.7 km  
Iota to Kappa: 162.1 km  
Iota to Lambda: 166.4 km  
Kappa to Lambda: 108.7 km  

Due to airspace restrictions, no direct flight path is permitted between Checkpoint Alpha and Checkpoint Beta.  
Furthermore, owing to overlapping mission windows, exactly one of the following two flight segments must be incorporated into the route: the segment between Beta and Gamma, or the segment between Gamma and Delta.  

The objective is to determine the shortest possible closed-loop flight path that visits each checkpoint exactly once and returns to the origin.
